purpose: Remove the externally supplied Task14 direction from the transparent margin program by inferring the controlled prompt's final subject number, while retaining background-factor membership and edit/no-edit as explicit intervention specifications.

predictions.pred_a_authority_and_v10_bound: All hashes hold and v10 remains screened.
predictions.pred_b_exact_subject_number_direction: Infer every labeled subject number and corresponding opposite-number direction on all 96 frozen Task14 endpoint texts.
predictions.pred_c_v7_equation_conformance: For every endpoint, 16 background subsets, and native/edit arms, the text API exactly matches v7 after labeled direction substitution (3,072 cases).
predictions.pred_d_strict_malformed_rejection: Reject non-string, empty, nonalphabetic-final-token, and unsupported ambiguous final-subject inputs.
predictions.pred_e_scope_and_price: Add zero learned scalars, fits, or model calls. Remove direction only; retain controlled raw text, E/A/U/W background membership, and edit specification.

terminal.invalid: Any authority, inference, conformance, rejection, or price check fails.
